source: Library and Archives Canada, Haldimand Papers MG 21, microfilm reel H-1649 (copies of British Library Add MS 21807-21808 made for the Public Archives of Canada, calendared by Brymner as B.147-148), on heritage.canadiana.ca as oocihm.lac_reel_h1649 (1266 images)
fetch_method: the viewer page lists every image's IIIF Image API 2 identifier in its #pvPageSelect options (saved to seq_to_iiif.tsv, all 1266); info.json and default.jpg at image-uab.canadiana.ca answer 403 to a plain request and 200 with a browser User-Agent plus a Referer header of the viewer page; one request at a time, 1.6 s apart
requests: heritage.canadiana.ca 3 (1 viewer page, 1 script, 1 probe), image-uab.canadiana.ca 12 (2 info.json incl. one 403, 7 reference copies incl. one 404 on a mapping gap since fixed, 3 native)
rights: LAC microfilm of BL manuscripts, 18th-century text; reel served openly by Canadiana
